rules.label: Free care (100% discount)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is at or below 100% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

rules.label: Up to 80% discount
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 100% and below 125% of the FPL would be eligible for up to an 80% discount.

rules.label: Up to 60% discount
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 125% and below 150% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 60% discount.

rules.label: Up to 40% discount
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 150% and below 200% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 40% discount.

rules.label: Up to 20% discount
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 200% and below 250% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 20% discount.

eca_not_before.quote: No extraordinary collection action will be taken before 182 days from the first bill.

notes: The policy states that patients with income exceeding 250% FPL may be considered for financial assistance on a case-by-case basis for catastrophic illness or medical indigence at the discretion of RGH.
The policy excludes physician fees or other charges from non-employee providers.

The policy applies to hospital, clinics and all employed providers including inpatient, emergency room, family practice clinic providers, and specific physicians listed; does not apply to radiologists from Colorado Imaging Associates, specialists from San Luis Valley Health, Health One cardiology, vascular institute of the Rockies, and certain surgeons.
The policy states that financial assistance is not considered a substitute for personal responsibility and patients are expected to cooperate and contribute based on ability to pay.
The policy states that the determination of financial need may be done at any point in the collection cycle and re-evaluated every 12 months or if financial situation changes.
The policy states that accounts may be considered for financial assistance up to six months prior to the determination date and up to one year after the determination date.
The policy states that RGH will notify the patient or applicant in writing within 30 days of receipt of a completed application.

The policy states that RGH will refrain from initiating Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECA) for Emergency Care provided by RGH, including emergency and inpatient care and attached ancillary services.
The policy states that any account engaged in ECA that is determined qualified under financial assistance, RGH will take all reasonably available measures to reverse any ECA.
The policy states that RGH will follow all Colorado DSH and Colorado Hospital Discount Care rules for patients qualifying under financial assistance.

dropped.claim: The policy's deadline for a patient to SUBMIT a financial-assistance application is 240 days after the first post-discharge bill (alone, or as one of several 'the later of' options)
